errors.text_span: presented from left to right in alphabetical order
errors.evidence: The models on the horizontal axis are not in alphabetical order (e.g., 'RoBERTa' is followed by 'ExEnt').

errors.text_span: The bars are grouped by color
errors.evidence: Using the term 'grouped' is ambiguous for this chart. The bars are individual and differentiated by color according to the legend, not presented in groups.
The description provides an incorrect and incomplete label for the tallest bar. The full label in the legend is 'LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)'.

errors.text_span: followed by LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum) at approximately 61%
errors.evidence: The description hallucinates a data point. The model 'LaSQuE (syn2real + curriculum)' is the tallest bar at ~62%, and there is no other data point for this model, nor is there a bar at 61%.
The bar for 'LaSQuE (mean)' has a value of approximately 46.5%, not 55%.
The bar for 'ExEnt' has a value of approximately 55%, not 56%. While a close approximation, the description also incorrectly orders it in the sequence of values.
The bar for 'RoBERTa w/o Exp' has a value of approximately 46%, not 52%.
The description completely omits the green bar corresponding to the 'LaSQuE' model, which has an accuracy of approximately 46.5%.

errors.text_span: All bars are listed in order of appearance from left to right
errors.evidence: This statement is false. The preceding sentence attempts to list the bars in descending order of height, not left-to-right order. Additionally, that list is incomplete and contains errors.
